title: Lua: Default Dumper to pcapng
description:
Default the Lua Dumper to pcapng. For pcapng, default the encapsulation
to PER_PACKET which, like NONE, will generate IDBs as necessary on demand
for each new encapsulation written. For all other types, continue to
default to Ethernet. Giving an encapsulation type like Ethernet to
pcapng will result in writing a generated IDB for Ethernet if there are
no records of that type.

Lua: Default Dumper to pcapng

Default the Lua Dumper to pcapng. For pcapng, default the encapsulation
to PER_PACKET which, like NONE, will generate IDBs as necessary on demand
for each new encapsulation written. For all other types, continue to
default to Ethernet. Giving an encapsulation type like Ethernet to
pcapng will result in writing a generated IDB for Ethernet if there are
no records of that type.
